terms.title: Terms and Conditions

blocks.text: You must provide accurate information, protect your login credentials, and take responsibility for activity performed through your account. Notify CoLearn if you believe your account has been accessed without permission.
CoLearn may be used for lawful learning, collaboration, mentoring, project development, and portfolio building.
You must not:

items: Harass, threaten, deceive, or impersonate others.
Upload illegal, harmful, abusive, or misleading content.
Spam users or promote scams.
Plagiarize work or falsely claim skills and achievements.
Introduce malware or interfere with platform security.

blocks.text: Courses, resources, mentor feedback, XP, badges, endorsements, and skill-verification features support learning and progress. They are not formal academic qualifications, professional licences, or employment guarantees unless explicitly stated.
Users are responsible for communicating respectfully, completing agreed responsibilities, and crediting contributors properly.

You retain ownership of original content you create. By uploading content, you allow CoLearn to store and display it as necessary to operate the platform.
You must have the right to upload your content and must not violate another person’s intellectual-property or privacy rights.
CoLearn may remove content or restrict, suspend, or terminate accounts that violate these Terms, harm other users, create security risks, or misuse the platform.
CoLearn may update, change, suspend, or discontinue features. Continuous or error-free access is not guaranteed.

CoLearn does not guarantee employment, income, certification, project success, or specific learning outcomes. Users are responsible for their decisions, collaborations, and use of information obtained through the platform.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: CoLearn respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information is collected, why it is used, and the choices available to users.

blocks.text: CoLearn may collect:

items: Your name, email address, profile image, and login information.
Skills, interests, biography, education, and portfolio details.
Course progress, projects, tasks, XP, badges, and achievements.
Posts, comments, messages, reviews, and uploaded files.
Device, browser, IP address, and platform-usage information.
Information provided when contacting support.

blocks.text: Information may be used to:

items: Create and secure accounts.
Provide learning and project features.
Suggest other members to connect and collaborate with.
Track progress and display achievements.
Support communication and collaboration.
Prevent fraud, abuse, and security threats.
Improve platform performance and user experience.
Send essential account and service notifications.

blocks.text: Information users choose to publish—such as their name, profile, skills, projects, portfolio, and community posts—may be visible to other users or the public.
Private account information must not be displayed publicly without permission.
CoLearn does not sell personal information.
Information may be shared with service providers required to operate the platform, when legally required, to protect users and platform security, or when a user gives permission.
CoLearn may use cookies or browser storage for authentication, preferences, security, and essential platform functions.
CoLearn uses reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect information. However, no online system can guarantee complete security.
Information is retained only for as long as necessary to provide the service, meet legal requirements, resolve disputes, and protect the platform.
Users may request to:

items: Access or correct their information.
Update profile visibility.
Delete content where applicable.
Request account deletion.
Withdraw optional consent.

blocks.text: Requests may be submitted to the contact email below.
Users must meet the minimum digital-consent age applicable in their location. Users below the legal age of majority should use CoLearn with permission from a parent or legal guardian.
CoLearn may update this Privacy Policy when its services or data practices change. Significant changes will be communicated through the platform or another reasonable method.
For privacy questions or data requests, contact:
hello@colearn.dev
